notes.notes:

Even the shark decided to dress up for the holidays! 🦈

[h2]VISIT SANTA'S ISLAND AND GET GIFTS![/h2]
Every day during the holiday event, you will receive a waybill for traveling to Santa's Island!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/46f6cd4cd893eb51d6daab375db6925d92fa7295.png[/img]

Santa's gifts await you on the island - new blueprints, customization, a Christmas tree for your raft, and many other surprises!

Get a Christmas tree on Santa's Island and don't forget to bring your decorations - it's time to decorate the Christmas tree! Get in the holiday spirit on your raft!

On Santa's Island, you'll be able to find new blueprints for holiday buildings - make sure to get them while the holiday event is running!

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/c35d97c696096ff3a68fbd4e94839f26322db4f7.jpg[/img]  
[h3]Water Improvements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] color changes depending on the time of day  
[*] added bottom to the water  
[*] floating objects now lag less and are pulling better  
[/list]  
[h3]New Resources on Islands[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] coal and iron ore can now be mined  
[*] ore can be smelted in the smelter  
[/list]  
[h3]Performance Enhancements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] higher FPS  
[*] reduced memory consumption  
[/list]  
[h3]New Buildings[/h3]  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/4ae2583d91aefd5c8f6a4e6183c1d8c60713d7e3.jpg[/img]  
[h3]Many Bugs Fixed:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] especially in multiplayer  
[*] during save load  
[*] reduced speed of the trading raft  
[*] pirate customization set is now wearable  
[*] camera rotation while sitting fixed  
[*] interface now scales more correctly on different monitors  
[*] improved gamepad support  
[/list]  
[h3]Hook Improvements[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] throws faster  
[*] auto-pickup  
[*] auto-pull
[*] increased pull speed  
[/list]  
[h3]Technical Updates to Enable More Frequent Releases:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Unity update  
[*] refactoring of old code  
[*] cleaning and optimizing the project  
[/list]

notes.title: GLOBAL UPDATE IS AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/3a5da1e6d6c4adfed133da9e7c0581ded045a600.png[/img]

You are waiting for a lot of new buildings, resources, game mechanics and other interesting innovations!


[h2]NEW RESOURCES ON THE ISLANDS[/h2]

We have added new resources to the islands - coal, stone and various ores. You will need these resources for new and some old buildings, so craft a pickaxe and go to the islands in search of new resources!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/24b38fe22497d8faf3f3283928e6d71705bf7387.png[/img]

To smelt ore into ingots, you will need to build a smelter, which we also added in this update.


[h2]NEW BUILDINGS[/h2]

We have added a lot of new buildings that will not only add comfort to your raft but also help you survive! A zipline will allow you to quickly move around the raft, a mechanical watermaker will provide you with several portions of water at once, and a improved anchor does not need to be changed after each use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/3b1347d05c6ee7a0899acf30d7a7cb51ae2c14e7.png[/img]

In the next update, we will add even more options for interacting with new buildings. And now you can use a thunderstorm - build a charger for a lightning rod and you can charge old batteries!

[h3]Blueprints from the Merchant:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Log floor
[*] Log ceiling
[*] Corner log ceiling
[*] Corner log floor
[*] Exquisite column
[*] Hammock
[*] Wall shelf
[*] Improved anchor
[*] Charger
[*] Zipline
[*] Bunk bed
[*] Trash can
[*] Pet house
[*] Basket
[*] Pool Spa
[*] Bench
[*] Wall picture
[*] Barrel
[*] Stacks of books
[*] Mug
[*] Glassful
[*] Spoon
[*] Fork
[*] Cookie jar
[*] Coffee machine
[*] Kettle
[*] Teapot
[*] LCD monitor
[*] PC keyboard
[*] PC mouse
[*] PC
[*] Pet bowl
[*] Pier
[/list]

[h3]Blueprints from the islands:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Kerosene lamp
[*] Candle
[*] CRT monitor
[*] Mailbox
[*] Safe
[*] Wheelbarrow
[/list]

[h3]Unlocked at a certain level:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corner floor at level 1
[*] Corner ceiling at level 6
[*] Pickaxe at level 10
[*] Electrical components at level 14
[*] Smelter at level 22
[*] Mechanical watermaker at level 23
[/list]


[h2]MOVING BUILDINGS[/h2]

You have arranged your raft, but decided to make a rearrangement? No problem! Now you don't have to destroy buildings and lose resources - move finished buildings with a hammer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/199fb24ff0abf9de201a2caeeb114998f78418e9.png[/img]


[h2]UPDATED COMPASS[/h2]

You will definitely not get lost on the islands, because now the compass shows the direction to the nearest important objects - notes, keys, chests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/510fe2c0000990ef742d90f0662501bd431df0b3.png[/img]


[h2]LOST RAFTS[/h2]

You are not the only one who was able to survive in the ocean, but not everyone is as lucky as you. Therefore, you will be able to meet abandoned rafts, peacefully drifting in the middle of the ocean. Get to the raft, there will obviously be something to profit from. And don't forget the anchor!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/9f0758d472f921c2ef3d7edd9df60df5fa125c75.png[/img]


[h2]CLOTHING DYING[/h2]

Down with boring outfits, now you can dye your clothes in any color you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/4d27b93a7225210018a076963377d5e84b4977a3.png[/img]


[h2]PHOTOMODE[/h2]

Share your amazing shots with your friends with the new photo mode! Choose the weather, time of day, pose and angle, take a picture and it will be saved in your Steam library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/6482734a8fa29d63613e2ea825ad08d3df589bf4.png[/img]


[h2]OTHER CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bottled water now leaves an empty bottle after use
[*] Old blueprints have been rebalanced taking into account new resources
[*] Now you can change Creative Mode settings right in the game
[*] Improved and fixed third-person animations
[*] Added new visual effects on the islands
[*] Mouse inversion mode has been added to the game settings
[*] Added "Big Heads" mode in the game settings
[*] Added useful tips to the game loading screen
[*] The work of servers in PvP mode has been changed, which should reduce the match waiting time
[/list]

And many other small changes and fixes.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: The update is now available!
New update for Survive on Raft!
GLOBAL UPDATE FOR «SURVIVE ON RAFT» IS AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[h1]GLOBAL UPDATE FOR «SURVIVE ON RAFT» AVAILABLE ON STEAM![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/405d4c59e4e65cbc3248e2dac98aeaf2a0354c5b.png[/img]

Many long-awaited features and new adventures are waiting for you, in which you can go with your friends!


[h2]MULTIPLAYER[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/f3d800a22d72902194b5fe21588c99d425f31baa.png[/img]

[b]You asked — we did![/b] You can play Survive On Raft with your friends now!

Get resources, build your raft and help each other survive in this endless and dangerous ocean. Remember, teamwork is your key to survival!

But if you did quarrel, then you can always sort things out with the help of a duel on spears (just do not forget to put all your resources in the chests before that).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/28eb44579dfae290bd9ce976cafb1d386f24254a.png[/img]


[h2]CUSTOMIZATION[/h2]

Especially for those who like to show their individuality through appearance, we have prepared a amazing wardrobe!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/1ccc17246c3f0d0cd8f9262096889713e7d7952a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/95fc826300c9a55ca2559330c17435c484cc5b11.png[/img]

In it you will find clothes for every taste and appearance of your character — choose gender, skin color, hairstyle, facial hair and more!


[h2]ISLANDS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/5167ca9808abf0f3553870adeec79dfb16ee1940.png[/img]

Once you customize your character and team up with your friends, you can immediately go on a journey to islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/e3b62bf167278feb99786fea9568e9c175902f99.png[/img]

First, you will need to get blueprints of new item — Islands Scanner. And then build this device on your raft, scan the area and get a waybill.

It seems that you are already ready to go to the island... But how to get there? And for this you will need another new building — a kayak! And of course an anchor to keep your raft from drifting away while you wander around the islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/1bfa989f00df75e684507390b96c35cd1e5faa83.png[/img]

And our advice to you is to prepare for excursions to the islands in advance. You definitely need a strategic supply of food, water and some kind of weapon, because you do not want to suffer from local creatures or die of hunger during your journey?

So, where can I get the radar blueprints for the islands? And more on that below.


[h2]WANDERING MERCHANT[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/f3689f21247f525b4380f1a510af8295af230cfb.png[/img]

Once a day, you can meet a wandering merchant, from whom you can purchase various goods and blueprints for Shells. Just don't forget to prepare for the meeting with the merchant and gather up more resources to exchange them for Shells! The merchant sails past your raft at approximately 9:00 PM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/1a54d2ef0155c11a043d5fec451a06e0fe90b5f3.png[/img]

Each meeting the merchant will need certain resources, for which he will give more Shells. And in order to prepare well for the next meeting, you can ask him for a list of the necessary resources in advance.

And you can also talk with him and listen to his useful advice. Some of them will definitely come in handy on your adventures!


[h2]NEW MECHANICS[/h2]

[h3]Thunderstorm[/h3]
The rain that caught you on a raft in the middle of the ocean is an unpleasant thing... But even worse is a thunderstorm. An insidious element can create a commotion on your raft with one lightning strike. To avoid this, it is advisable to have a lightning rod.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/fdda46933233286882dace2478b610a1b56505b9.png[/img]

[h3]Fire[/h3]
If a lightning strike could not be avoided, then get ready to become a firefighter. And you better hurry, for your raft of planks is very susceptible to fire. We advise you to stock up on fire extinguishers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/7b63a612c117af6b1b8112391d2ea3ec14487973.png[/img]


[h2]NEW BUILDINGS AND CRAFT[/h2]

[h3]Islands Scanner[/h3]
Want to get to the islands? But first you need to find them ... And a new device will help with this - the radar of the islands! The radar scans the nearest area and, when an island is found, prints a route sheet with the location of the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/6d73a8e00e1125774aa7b86be987a56ed54c738e.png[/img]

[h3]Kayak[/h3]
Okay, you got the route sheet and you know where the island is. How to get to it? By kayak!

He will not only quickly take you to the desired island, but also allow you to get out of the island with the treasures found!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/ccff483c20e30ccdd5506b227221804f9a86d09e.png[/img]

[h3]Anchor[/h3]
But do not forget to anchor your raft, otherwise you risk not finding your raft on your return from the island. Sea currents are very tricky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/a8bfa7b74b909833c3f2b2bc6752dc95b0b0b17f.png[/img]

[h3]Lightning rod[/h3]
This anti-stray lightning device can save your raft from a merciless fire. Don't underestimate its usefulness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/cae4e055eae8f4458fb5e5658c5b5198f9039446.png[/img]


[h1]AND MANY OTHER CHANGES[/h1]

Which you can familiarize yourself with in the game. Have a good game!

notes.title: Global update for Survive On Raft! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h2]BEGINNING OF THE STORYLINE[/h2]
We begin to work more carefully on the storyline of the game. With each update we will add more new details that will clarify what is happening and give answers to numerous questions.

[i]The plane crashes in the Bermuda Triangle due to a sudden engine failure. The son of the main character disappears without a trace, like all other passengers, and the hero himself comes to life on the wreckage of a fallen plane.

Now he has to survive and find the missing son. But is everything so simple in this mysterious place? You will learn more about this later.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/062178c777fb2e08c246085c1cf9f3b6e776fe90.png[/img]


[h2]HUMANITARIAN AID[/h2]
Sometimes you can see a plane or a boat. If you use the flare gun, which can be found in floating boxes, then cargo will be dropped from the plane or boat. It will help you in your survival.

Why don't they come to the rescue of the character? Who knows... Maybe they have not existed for a long time, and these are just ghostly phantoms of the ships and planes that once disappeared in Devil's Triangle...

Be that as it may, they can give you quite tangible help in the form of the necessary resources, most importantly — do not forget to use the flare gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/87d9425d0ca9c7bc1fdcf758d055045e588f7ae8.png[/img]


[h2]NEW MODELS AND ANIMATIONS[/h2]
We updated the character’s hand models, changed the old animation and added a new animation. We hope that you will like these changes and will allow you to plunge even deeper into the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/f4db5fd505e250424b88d291d59a6c4d6ed3f45b.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/1080553a8a2aeab45485f44569f5dc093a1ecb8b.gif[/img]


[h3]WHAT'S NEW?[/h3]
▸ Added new types of food
▸ Shark behavior has been slightly modified
▸ Added new and modified old sounds
▸ Added new features in creative mode
▸ Bugs fixed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35272493/ac09afbd68d49d9e14cecec9566102fc26f6f644.png[/img]
